description: The agent must: (1) Backup ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json using the date-stamped cp command from Step 1. (2) Run 'openclaw agents add logistics-group-bot --workspace /workspace/agents/logistics-group-bot --non-interactive' — critically using the --non-interactive flag which is a proprietary requirement not obvious from general knowledge. (3) Run 'python3 /workspace/skills/openclaw-create-agent/scripts/upsert_openclaw_agent.py --config ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json --agent-id logistics-group-bot --routing-mode peer --peer-kind group --peer-id oc_logistics_team_42x' — using peer routing mode with the correct peer-kind and peer-id. The proprietary trap is that the script enforces 'session.dmScope = per-account-channel-peer', which the agent must allow to happen (not override it). (4) Run 'openclaw gateway restart' to restart the gateway. (5) Crucially, the existing ops-assistant binding, acct-ops-001 account entry, and agents.json entry must remain intact (no clobbering). An agent without the SKILL.md would likely use account routing mode, forget --non-interactive, or not know to call the upsert script at all.
